values: Source: User feedback, 31 October 2026. Website: https://progent-website.vercel.app/
Figma and reference-site mentions reflect the feedback provided. No design files or reference URLs were supplied.
The header animation while scrolling from the hero to the second fold looks fine.
The header CTA style differs from the Figma design.
Match the CTA styling to the Figma design.
A visible circle shape appears during the transition. This shape is not part of the design.
Fade out the white hero section while revealing layers through circular masking at the same time. The result should feel like one smooth transition.
The Challenge label and the “Your business knows how work…” headline look fine.
Retain the current treatment of this copy.
The background pixel/grid texture is placed statically and does not respond to the cursor.
Reveal and animate the texture on hover, driven by cursor movement.
The highlighted challenge text remains visible as the next content enters.
After the full text highlight completes, dissolve/fade out The Challenge label and the centered headline/paragraph before revealing the next text.
The next text enters from below instead of appearing at its intended position.
Once the challenge copy fades out, reveal this text with a motion blur effect at its exact Figma position. Do not move the text up from below.
Cards currently rise from below with a dissolve effect, and the overall movement feels unsmooth.
Only the cards should enter from below. Refine their entry and timing so the sequence flows smoothly after the text reveal.
Overall scrolling feels unsmooth. I suspect Lenis has not been added.
Verify whether Lenis is integrated and implement/refine smooth scrolling. The suspected missing integration is not a confirmed technical finding.
Reveal animations are missing across section titles, supporting text and cards.
Add consistent reveal animations to section titles, subtext and cards throughout the page.
The pixel effect is still missing while scrolling below the second fold. The texture looks merely placed on the page.
Implement the intended cursor-driven hover response wherever this pixel texture appears.
The bento cards appear much too large.
Reduce the card/grid scale and align the proportions with the intended design.
The pixel line grid remains static.
Make the line grid respond to hover and cursor movement.
Reveal animation is missing and there are large gaps in the sequence.
Reveal “How it works” first, followed by the main title. Tighten the animation timing and remove excessive gaps.
The heading progression does not feel properly staged.
After the title loads, move it slightly upward and reduce its size, or let it gradually scroll upward, as described in the intended sequence.
The card transitions do not match the smoothness of the Zux reference website. The interaction feels force-fitted.
Refine the card entry, transition continuity and scroll timing to match the fluidity of the Zux reference.
The Lenis-like smoothness and heading/H1 and subtext reveal animations appear to be missing.
Improve the smooth scrolling feel and add reveal animations to the main heading and supporting text.
The pixel grid below Outcomes is not implemented properly.
Rebuild/refine the grid to match the intended cursor-driven pixel effect.
The industry section interaction and images look fine.
Retain the current image treatment and core interaction.
Reveal animations are missing from the heading and subtext.
Add reveal animations to the heading and supporting text.
The previously described pixel effect on hover is missing.
Add the cursor-driven pixel hover effect as briefed.
The success story section still feels static and unfinished.
Add the intended motion and reveal treatment so the section feels complete.
The article section feels completely static and has no reveal animation.
Add reveal animations to the article section and its content.
The current animation looks very good, but it does not match the reference website.
Keep the visual quality while aligning the animation behavior with the reference website.
The animated path looks like a separate patch on the background.
Reveal the path with scroll progress and blend it into the background using a linear gradient from below.
There is too much black space below the FAQ section and above Why now.
Reduce the excess vertical space before Why now.
See how your own tool / Footer
The image interaction and finger-touch animation near the footer look fine.
The footer does not load through the intended pixel effect from the same touch interaction. This was briefed previously and remains unresolved.
Use the finger touch to trigger a pixel-based reveal of the footer, as previously briefed.
